root_cause: The getNextActiveElement utility does not skip disabled elements, causing arrow key navigation to move focus to disabled tabs.
repair_strategy: Update getNextActiveElement to iterate in the requested direction, skipping any elements where isDisabled returns true, while preserving wrapping behavior and providing a fallback to the original element if no enabled elements are found.
expected_accessibility_effect: ArrowRight will now move focus from the Account tab to the Billing tab, skipping the disabled Notifications tab, resulting in the Billing tab being selected and its panel becoming visible.
functional_risks: Altered navigation behavior for other components that use getNextActiveElement (e.g., dropdowns, navbars) if they relied on disabled items being focusable.
Possible infinite loop if all elements in a list are disabled (mitigated by step count limit).
Fallback to original element may produce unexpected focus when no enabled items exist.
verification_requirements: Verify ArrowRight skips disabled Notifications tab and selects Billing tab.
Verify ArrowLeft wraps from Account to Billing when Notifications is disabled.
Ensure tab navigation works correctly when no tabs are disabled.
Confirm that other widgets using getNextActiveElement (e.g., dropdown menus) retain expected behavior.
